name: 82201 · Wheatland, WY
findings: ZIP 82201 (Wheatland) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 82201 (Wheatland) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 82201 (Wheatland) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
